 Oct 23 (Reuters) - Jaguar Land Rover will recall 93,997 ​vehicles in the United ‌States as the rearview camera image may fail ​to appear on ​the display, the US National ⁠Highway Traffic Safety ​Administration (NHTSA) said on Friday. Here ​are some more details: Sign up here. 
 NHTSA said insufficient drain holes may ​trap water in ​the rearview camera and damage it. 
 The ‌recall ⁠affects certain 2022-2026 Land Rover Range Rover vehicles, according to ​the auto ​safety ⁠regulator. 
 Dealers will drill additional drain holes ​in the underside ​of ⁠the tailgate trim and replace the camera ⁠if ​needed, NHTSA ​said. 
 Reporting by Sumedha Mukherjee in Bengaluru; ​Editing by Shounak Dasgupta
